operandInputs.origin: Branch of valid sexagenary day pillar; 子=0…亥=11, 申=8 酉=9. No Month Jian or lunarMonth required.

predicate.derivation: 通書以申酉日為除神; explicit 日神不從年月天干起義 and day chart establish month/stem independence.

coverage.structuralDomain: All 60 valid day pillars; 10 present / 50 absent. Optional 12×60 month-independence regression, not required Month Jian input.
coverage.calendarCoverage: Inherited from validated day-pillar provider; no separate dated restriction

exceptions.detail: No source clause deletes 申/酉 presence; heading 忌/protection/override remains separate.
五離同位 has distinct negative usage; do not copy marriage/friends/contracts 忌 into 除神 宜/scoring.

conflicts.detail: 義同除日 describes usage, not presence equality: 除日 monthly offset +1, 除神 fixed 申/酉; 卷十一 lists both.
五離 same day positions, distinct named 宜/忌. No token alias adopted.
